hero.headline:
Send what they need to hear.
Without making it weird.
hero.subtitle: An emotionally charged, anonymous video recommendation platform. Like slipping a handwritten note under someone's door in the digital age.

flow.slide1Desc: Say what they need to hear — a note, or any video link.
flow.slide2Desc: They'll never know it was you.
flow.slide3Desc: Reveal yourself anytime — it's always your choice.

anonymous.title: Completely Anonymous
anonymous.desc: They won't know it's you unless you want them to. A safe space for genuine recommendations.

resonant.title: Emotionally Resonant
resonant.desc: Attach the perfect mood tag and a brief note to set the context before they even press play.

delivery.title: Your Choice of Delivery
delivery.desc: Send a private anonymous link straight to them, or drop it into Blind Circle for organic community discovery.

howItWorks.heading: From link to sent, in under a minute
howItWorks.subheading: Paste a video, say what you mean, and it's on its way — anonymously.

paste.title: Paste any video link
paste.desc: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook — or upload your own.

note.title: Add a note, stay anonymous
note.desc: Say what you mean. They'll never know it came from you.

sent.title: Sent — that's it
sent.desc: We'll let you know the moment it's seen.

noAwkwardness.heading: The message lands. Not the moment.
noAwkwardness.body: When you say something sensitive out loud, you're also managing how they react to you saying it. Blind Whisper takes you out of the room — so they can actually sit with what you meant, instead of studying your face while you say it.

before.label: Saying it out loud
before.desc: They brace for how you'll say it. You brace for how they'll take it. The message gets lost somewhere in that tension.

after.label: Whisping it instead
after.desc: They watch it alone, on their own time, at their own pace. Just the message — no performance, no bracing, no awkward pause after.

useCases.heading: The conversations Blind Whisper makes easier
useCases.subheading: Every relationship has something that's easier to send than to say. Here are the kinds of moments people use Blind Whisper for.

parent.quote: I wanted to talk to her about something sensitive, but I didn't want her focused on my reaction instead of the message. She watched it on her own time — and I've already seen her trying a new approach. No awkwardness.

friend.quote: He was going through a breakup and I didn't know what to say without it sounding like a lecture. I sent a video instead. He told me later it was exactly what he needed — and it just felt like it arrived, not like I'd said it.

partner.relationship: A partner, opening a hard conversation
partner.quote: There's a difference between "we need to talk" and just... showing them something. I sent this instead of starting a fight. It opened the door gently instead of slamming it.

colleague.quote: I wanted a teammate to see something about giving feedback well, without it feeling like a performance review. Anonymous meant it landed as a nudge, not a callout.

sibling.quote: We don't really "talk" talk. But I could send him something that said what I couldn't figure out how to say out loud.

useCases.disclaimer: Illustrative examples of how people use Blind Whisper, not verified customer reviews.

closingCta.body: You don't have to find the perfect words. Just find the video, and let it say what you meant.
